update.title: Unified Work Report logic across CLI and automation
update.summary: Moved Work Report operations into one reusable core and gave YAML, JSON, and CSV evidence a shared loading path.

blocks.body:
## One core for every caller

Work Report’s report creation, validation, Git inspection, artifact parsing, and storage operations moved into one reusable core. The CLI and automation tools call the same functions instead of carrying separate copies of report behavior.

blocks.description: The shared loader selects the parser by file type, preserving YAML structures instead of sending them through JSON parsing.

blocks.body:
## Preserve structured evidence

YAML evidence is parsed as YAML rather than falling through a JSON-only path. The shared loader keeps mappings and lists intact for report, graph, and portfolio handling, while JSON and CSV follow the same entry point.
